conservative.requirements: Must have at least one Advanced Active Defence action card

reckless.requirements: Must have at least one Advanced Active Defence action card. After an engaged ally has been declared the target of a Melee Attack or Ranged Attack, add two recharge tokens to this card to add {Dc} to the action’s dice pool. Special: After performing the Bodyguard b Active Defence, the soak value of the defended ally is increased by +1 until the end of the round. If your defended ally is hit by the triggering attack anyway, you suffer 1 wound.
